competing_explanation: Additional Haze4K-to-ITS overlaps may remain among the 574 parent-unresolved groups, and some directly accepted ITS IDs may be visually duplicated members rather than one privileged source filename. The assets therefore define conservative known-overlap quarantine populations, not complete source disjointness.
gate_reasons: All nine frozen identity, direct-evidence, official-membership, tier-count and capacity gates passed.
The training-exposure complement retained 9,347 official ITS scenes and the training-plus-selection-exposure complement retained 8,813, both above the frozen minimum of 6,000.
limitations: The conjectured total of 500 indoor relationships was not used as a gate.
No ITS-to-ITS transitive family expansion was used.
The assets quarantine verified direct overlaps only and do not prove that no additional Haze4K-to-ITS overlap remains.
Future measurement must describe its population as known-overlap-quarantined rather than fully source-disjoint.
No image content, model, inference, training, outcome metric, confirmation, canary or locked-test evidence was accessed.
primary_result: The deterministic census verified all 426 accepted direct Haze4K-to-ITS relationships against the qualified 11,000-scene official ITS copy. The Haze4K-training exposure tier quarantines 1,653 ITS IDs and leaves 9,347 eligible scenes. The training-plus-selection exposure tier quarantines 2,187 ITS IDs and leaves 8,813 eligible scenes. All frozen gates passed, so these two assets are authorized for a separately frozen known-overlap-quarantined measurement design.
